title: Decoupled microcontroller
prompt: Design a printed circuit board carrying a microcontroller in a quad flat package, two 100nF decoupling capacitors adjacent to its power pins, and a 4-pin programming header. Board outline at most 50mm × 50mm, two copper layers. Declare power (VCC, GND) and programming signal nets, place all four components, and route every net so its copper is fully connected — decoupling capacitors must actually connect the MCU power pins to VCC and GND. The board must pass a design-rule check clean. Output a .vcad document containing the board as a PcbBoard node.
